dioscorides.excerpt: στοιχάς· γεννᾶται μὲν ἐν ταῖς κατὰ Γαλατίαν νήσοις κατ' ἀντικρὺς Μασσαλίας, καλουμέναις Στοιχάσιν, ὅθεν καὶ τὴν ὀνομασίαν ἔσχεν·
dioscorides.edition: Wellmann, Pedanii Dioscuridis Anazarbei De materia medica, vol. II (Berlin 1906), p. 36; read off the archive.org page image (item b21459162_0002) and cross-checked against two OCR layers; ϑ printed as θ

identification.source: Sprengel 1830, vol. 2, pp. 507-508 (Comm. III cap. XXVIII): name from the Stoechades islands off Massilia (Hyères); 'Planta, de qua sermo est, Lavandula Stoechas nobis dicitur, a Fuchsio, ni fallor, primo illustrata.' No competing candidate named. | Fraas 1845, pp. 174-175: '4. Lavandula Stoechas' = στιχάς, στοιχάς Diosc. 3,31, Plin.; modern χαμολίβανο (μαυροκέφαλο sec. Sibthorp); on xirobouna (Hymettus to 1000 ft) and damper lowlands. Osbaldeston 2000, ch. 3-31 STOICHAS: SUGGESTED Stichas, Stichas arabica [Fuchs], Stoechas purpurea [Bauhin], Lavandula stoechas. (https://archive.org/details/BIUSante_dioscsprengelx02/page/n509/mode/1up ; https://archive.org/details/synopsisplantaru00fraa/page/n219/mode/1up)
